# Shared Obsidian vault notes

The repository root is the Granny vault. No community plugins are required, and no unverified configuration keys are committed during initialization.

Recommended manual settings:

- enable Backlinks, Outgoing Links, Properties, Templates, Search, and Local Graph;
- configure `docs/_templates` as the Templates folder;
- keep links updated when files are renamed;
- keep deleted files in Obsidian trash or system trash according to team preference;
- do not commit workspace/layout state (covered by `.gitignore`).

This file intentionally documents shared expectations while keeping the vault portable across Obsidian versions and machines.
